crit_percent.description: At or above this usage the widget switches to the error color.
crit_percent.label: Critical threshold (%)

display.description: What the widget shows next to the icon.
display.label: Bar text

glyph.description: Tabler icon shown in the bar.
glyph.label: Glyph

glyph_color.description: "By threshold" colors the icon by how full the disk is; the other options pin a palette role.
glyph_color.label: Icon color

mount.description: Path to watch, e.g. / or /home. A device (/dev/nvme0n1p2) or any directory inside the filesystem works too. Leave empty to follow the busiest disk.
mount.label: Mount point

refresh_seconds.description: How often the statvfs snapshot is re-read (2-600 seconds).
refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (s)

show_glyph.description: Turn off to keep only the text.
show_glyph.label: Show icon

show_subvolumes.label: Show subvolume usage
show_subvolumes.description: List the usage of each mounted btrfs subvolume / mount point in the lower half of the panel. statvfs cannot see this layer, so it is counted by traversal.

subvol_auto_scan.label: Scan when the panel opens
subvol_auto_scan.description: Start counting automatically when the panel opens if any subvolume is missing or stale (brief disk I/O). Turn it off to start manually from a row or the Scan button.

subvol_cache_minutes.label: Subvolume cache (minutes)
subvol_cache_minutes.description: How long a count stays fresh; older rows are shown as needing a recount.

subvol_paths.label: Extra paths to count
subvol_paths.description: Additional directories besides mounted subvolumes, separated by commas, e.g. /home/ylxc/.cache; ~ is supported.

subvol_size_mode.label: Subvolume size mode
subvol_size_mode.description: Used = real disk usage after compression (du default); Files = sum of apparent sizes; btrfs exclusive = excludes space shared with snapshots (needs btrfs-progs, some directories need root).

tooltip_max.description: Extra filesystems are collapsed into a single "+N more" row.
tooltip_max.label: Max disks in tooltip

tooltip_mounts.description: Adds one row per other filesystem to the hover tooltip.
tooltip_mounts.label: List all disks in the tooltip

warn_percent.description: At or above this usage the widget switches to the tertiary color.
warn_percent.label: Warning threshold (%)

subvol_card_tip: Click to recount only this one
subvol_note: Counted by traversal (no root): unmounted subvolumes are invisible, and space shared with snapshots is counted again.
title: Disk Usage
tt_hint: Left click: details · scroll: switch disk
